moves.desc: Share a piece of chaotic mana to corrupt a target until they break and serve the user.
moves.name: Chaos Corruption

moves.desc: An attack that adapts to the target's biggest weakness; spend 50% more to choose the effect.
moves.name: Chaotic Departure

moves.desc: Heal, but feel all the pain of regeneration.
moves.name: Pain Packer

moves.desc: Call any object, person or thing to shield the user.
moves.name: Divine Protection

dreone.name: Reonẽ Kurta
dreone.notes: Restored from the Google Drive sheet.

sections.body:
HP 420
Strength B+ · Endurance A · Agility A+ · Mana EX · Luck D · Noble Phantasm EX

- Presence Concealment (EX): spiritually unregistered; detection struggles to see him as a Servant.
- Divinity (A): corrupted divine core.
- Corruption Authority (A++): taints mana, bounded fields and constructs on contact.
- Whisper of Ruin (A+): speaking a target's name weakens their parameters.
- Adversary of Order (EX): command, contract and hierarchy skills weaken near him.

Noble Phantasm: Ahriman: Silent Eclipse of Creation (EX, Anti-Unit / Anti-Concept): strikes the body and the target's future survival odds; healing weakens, divine protection fractures.

drin.bio: Age 17. Chaotic / Neutral. Sharp-minded and tactical; believes in adapting faster than the opponent. Command seal: a circular flame sigil with three claw-like streaks.

moves.desc: Enhances speed and physical strikes with flame mana.
moves.name: Fire Cloak

moves.desc: Mid-range explosive spell.
moves.name: Fire Bomb

drin.name: Rin
drin.notes: Restored from the Google Drive sheet.

sections.body:
Strength D · Endurance D · Agility C · Mana C · Luck A- · Noble Phantasm E

- Observation (D): slowly analyzes enemy parameters; small accuracy bonus after long contact.
- Adaptive Growth (A++): parameters may rise after surviving fights; harder fights grow it more.

Noble Phantasm: Name undeclared (E, dormant): exists but has not awakened yet.

dtagah.bio: Age 16 (has lived for 7). Will of Fire sheet.

moves.desc: Fireball.
moves.name: Great Fireball Jutsu

moves.desc: Earth clones.
moves.name: Clones

moves.desc: Nearby rocks collapse and crush the enemy.
moves.name: Fire Lotus

moves.desc: A dragon-like head that shoots mud balls.
moves.name: Particle Style: Particle Storm

dtagah.name: Tagah Uchiha
dtagah.notes: Restored from the Google Drive sheet.

3k5b0ahwje.bio: A lean, silver-haired young man with a pale blue owl-feather mask that leaves his eyes glowing white, a black sleeveless high-collar top marked with a silver cross, long black gloves, and a white waist cloth. In his hooded battle garb he wears a feathered gray mantle and carries a cross-hilted longsword. A small blue owl companion with one glowing eye perches on his shoulder, and he carries himself with a calm, quietly amused air.

items.desc: A slender longsword with a cross hilt and a sky-blue gem. It conducts void and lightning magic cleanly.
items.name: Crossguard Nightblade

items.desc: A hooded gray-feathered cloak with silver embroidery. It muffles sound and resists wind and curse magic.
items.name: Plumed Warden's Mantle

items.desc: Black gauntlets with glowing blue gems that help him shape and hold void energy.
items.name: Clawed Gloves of Azure

moves.desc: Hurls the void sphere at a target. It detonates in a crackle of blue lightning and drags nearby enemies inward.
moves.name: Hollow Star Burst

moves.desc: A fast longsword slash that releases a spray of razor-sharp feathers in a wide arc.
moves.name: Feather Gale Cut

moves.desc: Vanishes into the dark and strikes from above with his familiar. The attack always crits against a marked enemy.
moves.name: Owl's Descent

moves.desc: Wraps allies in drifting feathers that raise their evasion and Magic DEF for 3 turns.
moves.name: Veil of Plumes

3k5b0ahwje.name: Noctis Vael, the Hushed Plume

sections.body: Calm, graceful, and a little playful. Noctis rarely raises his voice, usually answering with a soft hum and a knowing smile. He is fiercely protective of his owl and of anyone he has sworn to guard.

Chosen by the Night Owl Order as a young watcher, Noctis was gifted the feather mask and trained to guard sleeping towns from threats that come after dark. He wears his ceremonial light garb at rest and his hooded warden's gear when the hunt begins.

skills.desc: The owl-feather mask lets him see in total darkness, pierce illusions and invisibility, and read where enemies will move next.
skills.name: Nightsight Mask

skills.desc: His feathered mantle muffles all sound from his movement and softens falls, making him nearly impossible to hear or ambush.
skills.name: Silent Wings

skills.desc: He condenses a sphere of crackling void energy in his palm that pulls in nearby magic and projectiles, then releases the stored power in a single burst.
skills.name: Hollow Star

skills.desc: His blue owl scouts, shares its senses with him, and can mark enemies or carry out short-range strikes with razor feathers.
skills.name: Ghost Owl Familiar

skills.desc: At night or in darkness his Magic ATK and Speed rise steadily, but bright daylight dulls the bonus.
skills.name: Moonlit Resolve

tol17gltp9.bio: Verrath is a short-haired woman with vivid red hair, a red visor-blindfold strapped across her eyes, and a stoic, composed expression. She wears layered black plate over chainmail, with glowing red cruciform sigils across her breastplate, pauldrons and greaves. She carries a dark greatsword with a bat-winged crossguard, and holds a spiked, red-marked helm at her side.

items.desc: A dark blade with a winged crossguard and a red-lined grip. It deals bonus damage to marked or bleeding enemies.
items.name: Batwing Greatsword

items.desc: Black layered armor etched with glowing red crosses, worn over chainmail.
items.name: Crimson Sigil Plate

items.desc: A red band that blocks normal sight and grants mana-based perception in exchange.
items.name: Visor of the Blind Oath

items.desc: A dark helm marked with a red sigil, usually carried at her side between battles.
items.name: Spiked Oath Helm

moves.desc: A two-handed vertical strike from the planted-sword stance, leaving a glowing red cross that burns the target for 2 turns.
moves.name: Crimson Cross Cleave

moves.desc: She senses an incoming attack, parries it, and returns a precise strike that always lands as a critical hit.
moves.name: Blindfold Counter

moves.desc: Slams her spiked helm into an enemy, breaking guard and stunning them for 1 turn.
moves.name: Helm Bash

moves.desc: Her armor sigils flare, shielding nearby allies for 3 turns and absorbing damage equal to 20% of her max HP.
moves.name: Bloodlight Bulwark

tol17gltp9.name: Verrath Crimsonveil

sections.body: Calm, disciplined and quiet. She speaks little, trusts her senses over her eyes, and treats every fight as a vow she intends to keep.

Verrath swore a blood oath to an order of knights and gave up her sight to wear the crimson visor. In return she sees the world as flowing mana, and she has carried the order's black armor and blade alone since it fell.

skills.desc: The red visor replaces her eyesight with mana perception, letting her track enemies through darkness, smoke and illusions, and sense attacks before they land.
skills.name: Blind Sight Visor

skills.desc: The glowing sigil on her breastplate absorbs a portion of incoming damage and stores it as red mana, which fuels her next strike.
skills.name: Crimson Cross Ward

skills.desc: While her helm is worn, her Defense rises and she resists fear and mind effects. While it is off, her offense rises instead.
skills.name: Oath of the Black Helm

skills.desc: Red sigils on her legs let her brace against knockback and dash short distances without losing her footing.
skills.name: Sigil Greaves

skills.desc: Her mail layer reduces the damage of slashing and piercing attacks, and has a chance to reflect minor blows.
skills.name: Chainmail Reflex

qaf8s7u2bt.bio: A lean, pale young man with chin-length blond hair, half-lidded golden eyes and a lazy, smirking mouth, a lit cigarette always between his gloved fingers. He wears an olive-brown long coat with buckled straps and diamond-shaped studs over a laced cream shirt, with a wide perforated belt slung across his hips. A massive engraved greatsword with an eye-studded black hilt rests on his shoulder, and he fights with the bored calm of someone who has already seen how the fight ends.

items.desc: A huge slab-bladed sword with intricate engravings, a spiked black crossguard and a pommel studded with golden eyes and a red gem.
items.name: Watcher's Greatsword

items.desc: Reinforced gloves that keep his grip steady and protect him from curse backlash.
items.name: Black Leather Gloves

items.desc: A wide belt with circular cutouts that holds mana charms and a small armored pouch.
items.name: Perforated Hip Belt

items.desc: A cigarette that never burns out unless Last Drag is active, and fuels his smoke abilities.
items.name: Ever-Lit Cigarette

moves.desc: A heavy overhead swing from the shoulder-rest stance that cracks armor and stuns on a critical hit.
moves.name: Shoulder Cleaver

moves.desc: Dissolves into smoke and reappears behind a target, gaining a guaranteed critical on the next attack.
moves.name: Smoke Veil Step

moves.desc: The hilt's eyes flare red, marking every enemy in sight. Allies deal bonus damage to marked targets for 3 turns.
moves.name: Eyes Open

moves.desc: Etched patterns along the blade glow and release a wide arc of cursed blade aura across the whole front line.
moves.name: Engraved Tempest

moves.desc: A finishing slash wreathed in black smoke that deals extra damage to weakened or cursed enemies.
moves.name: Ashen Verdict

qaf8s7u2bt.name: Valten Ashgrave

sections.body: Cool, laid-back and quietly arrogant. Valten rarely raises his voice and treats most fights like an inconvenience, but he is fiercely loyal to the few people who earn his attention.

Once the youngest duelist of a sellsword order, Valten left after the order's cursed relic blade chose him as its wielder. He now wanders from town to town, hunting the source of the curse, and seeing him with the sword on his shoulder is usually the first sign that trouble has arrived.

skills.desc: The watching eyes on the sword hilt reveal enemy openings, letting Valten predict and counter attacks aimed at him.
skills.name: Many-Eyed Edge

skills.desc: Smoke from his cigarette thickens into a cloud that hides his movements and slows enemies who breathe it.
skills.name: Ember Haze

skills.desc: Curse-threaded mana makes the greatsword weigh almost nothing in his hands, but it hits with its full mass.
skills.name: Featherweight Colossus

skills.desc: When Valten is below half HP, his strikes gain power as the cigarette burns down; once it's gone, so is the bonus.
skills.name: Last Drag

skills.desc: Can draw small tools, charms and smoke bombs from his coat without spending a turn.
skills.name: Coat of Many Pockets

angeloguardian.name: Guardian of the Elements
angeloguardian.blurb: Angelo's tree: master nature, flame, aqua and sky, then unite all four guardians in his One Of One form.

nodes.d: Use your surroundings to build anything, or read an area at a glance.
Become a towering stone gorilla. 1,000 energy · 3,000 damage.
Magic roots spread through the ground to heal allies and trap enemies.
Every natural event and ecosystem nearby moves to protect you.
Flames enchant every attack you make and explode on impact.
The longer a battle goes, the more explosive mana you build up.
Become a phoenix whose fire never stops burning after impact. 3,000 energy · 5,000 damage.
Once per fight, when you would fall, rise from your own ashes at half HP.
A wall of water absorbs the next hit against you or an ally.
Call a warm rain that heals every ally in the area over 3 turns.
A serpent of water coils around an ally and counters anyone who strikes them.
Become living water: physical attacks pass through you and your healing doubles.
A burst of wind launches you or an ally high into the air.
Wings of wind let you fly for the whole fight.
Your wings crackle: every dive calls down a lightning strike.
Your wings sharpen: you can't be hit by ranged attacks while flying.
Become the storm itself: control wind and weather across the battlefield.
A mist only you can see through. It hides your aura, mana and attacks.
Wrap an ally in your guardian element to protect them. 2,000 energy.
Perfect senses, movement, tracking and critical strikes.
Spin the wheel of your guardians and bend any one element you've mastered. 10,000 energy · 1,000 damage.
Your One Of One form: nature, flame, aqua and sky guardians fuse into you at once.

irisarmory.name: Ember & Root Armory
irisarmory.blurb: A forge built into a giant tree. Weapons and armor for every guardian element.

items.name: Flamebrand Saber
items.desc: A curved blade that bursts into flame on a hit. +300 fire damage.

items.name: Rootwood Longbow
items.desc: Arrows sprout roots on impact and pin the target in place for a turn.

items.name: Tidecaller Spear
items.desc: Thrust to fire a jet of water; returns to your hand when thrown.

items.name: Skyrender Gauntlets
items.desc: Each punch releases a gust that knocks foes back 30 feet.

items.name: Soulsteel Dagger
items.desc: Cuts the soul, not the body: ignores armor and shields.

items.name: Stoneguard Plate
items.desc: Heavy plate grown from living stone. Reduces physical damage by 20%.

items.name: Emberweave Cloak
items.desc: Fire-resistant cloak; halves burn damage.

items.name: Guardian's Aegis
items.desc: A shield marked with all four guardian runes. Once per fight, block any single attack.

items.name: Iron Rations
items.desc: A week of food for the road.

items.name: Climbing Kit
items.desc: Rope, pitons and hooks.

irisapothecary.name: The Verdant Apothecary
irisapothecary.blurb: Shelves of glowing bottles under a mossy roof. Healing, mana and a few things she doesn't advertise.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.desc: Restores 1,000 HP.

items.name: Greater Healing Draught
items.desc: Restores 4,000 HP.

items.name: Mana Tonic
items.desc: Restores 2,000 energy.

items.name: Phoenix Ash
items.desc: Sprinkle on a fallen ally to revive them at half HP.

items.name: Stoneskin Salve
items.desc: Physical damage against you is halved for 3 turns.

items.name: Swiftwind Elixir
items.desc: Take an extra move every turn for 3 turns.

items.name: Antidote
items.desc: Cures poison and rot.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.desc: A thick cloud that blocks sight for 2 turns.

items.name: Dreamleaf Tea
items.desc: Drink before sleeping to see a vision of something the DM chooses.

items.name: Nightshade Extract
items.desc: Coat a weapon: the next hit poisons for 500 damage a turn for 3 turns.

iriscurios.name: Rift & Relic Curios
iriscurios.blurb: A shop that is slightly bigger inside than outside. Time, space and soul relics.

items.name: Hourglass of Borrowed Seconds
items.desc: Flip it to take a second turn right now. Recharges after each fight.

items.name: Chronometer of Echoes
items.desc: Replay the last 10 seconds of any place you stand in, as ghostly images.

items.name: Pocket Rift Pouch
items.desc: A pouch that holds a small room's worth of items.

items.name: Mirror of Futures
items.desc: Shows three possible outcomes of your next big decision.

items.name: Soul Lantern
items.desc: Its light reveals invisible spirits and soul-bound stands.

items.name: Stand Arrow
items.desc: Pierce a willing creature to awaken a stand within them. Not everyone survives it.

items.name: Compass of the Lost
items.desc: Points toward whatever you most want to find.

items.name: Cursed Gold Coin
items.desc: Lucky in every bet, until the debt comes due. The DM decides when.

items.name: Shard of the Divine Divide
items.desc: A splinter of the power to halve anything. Its owner can split one attack in two, forever.

iriswayfarer.name: Wayfarer's Stable & Supply
iriswayfarer.blurb: A big barn by the city gate. Tools for the road, mounts from horses to griffons, and everything you need to travel Iris.

items.name: Climbing Kit
items.desc: Pitons, hooks and a harness. Advantage on climbing checks.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.desc: Picks and tension wrenches for locks and traps.

items.name: Grappling Hook & 50 ft Rope
items.desc: Throw, hook, climb.

items.name: Spyglass
items.desc: See clearly up to a mile away.

items.name: Alchemist's Kit
items.desc: Brew potions on the road with the right ingredients.

items.name: Smith's Field Anvil
items.desc: A folding anvil and hammer to repair weapons and armor at camp.

items.name: Everburning Lantern
items.desc: Never needs oil. Its flame can't be blown out.

items.name: Wayfinder's Compass
items.desc: Always points toward the last place you rested safely.

items.name: Riding Horse
items.desc: Steady and fast on open roads. Speed 60 ft.

items.name: Pack Mule
items.desc: Carries twice what a horse can. Stubborn but loyal.

items.name: Armored Warhorse
items.desc: Trained for battle; doesn't panic under fire.

items.name: Swift Elk
items.desc: Leaps rivers and fallen trees. Never slowed by forest terrain.

items.name: Dire Wolf
items.desc: Fights beside you and tracks by scent. +1 attack per turn while mounted.

items.name: Giant Ember Lizard
items.desc: Walks through lava and fire unharmed. Breathes a short burst of flame.

items.name: Skyray
items.desc: A gliding manta of Iris's skies. Flies, and can carry two riders.

items.name: Griffon
items.desc: Flying mount. Dives for double damage on its first attack.

items.name: Phoenix Hatchling
items.desc: Grows into a fiery mount. Once per day it revives its rider at half HP.

items.name: Riding Saddle
items.desc: Fits most mounts.

items.name: Saddlebags
items.desc: Carry 10 more items on your mount.

items.name: Barding (Mount Armor)
items.desc: Your mount takes half damage from physical attacks.

items.name: Flying Harness
items.desc: Required to ride flying mounts safely.

items.name: Feed Sack (1 week)
items.desc: Keeps your mount fed and happy.

items.name: Traveler's Tent
items.desc: Sleeps two. Keeps out rain and wind.

items.name: Bedroll & Blanket
items.desc: A good night's sleep on the road.

items.name: Rations (1 week)
items.desc: Dried meat, hardtack and fruit.

items.name: Waterskin of Endless Water
items.desc: Never runs dry.

items.name: Map Case of Iris
items.desc: Holds a detailed map of the region you're in.

items.name: Camp in a Box
items.desc: Say the word and a full campsite unfolds: tent, fire and cookware.

irismissions.name: Iris Mission Board
irismissions.blurb: Jobs posted by the guild, the shops and anyone desperate enough to pay. Ranks run from F (anyone can do it) to ??? (no one knows what it is).

items.name: The Sealed Door Beneath Iris
items.desc: Something under the city has started knocking back. No one who opened the last door came out the same. Reward: unknown.

items.name: Whoever Wrote the World
items.desc: A page in no known language appeared on the board overnight. It's addressed to the party. Reward: unknown.

items.name: Halve the Endless Storm
items.desc: A storm that never ends is swallowing the coast. It must be cut apart at its heart.

items.name: The Four Guardians' Trial
items.desc: The old guardian spirits of nature, flame, aqua and sky have woken and want to test whoever claims their power.

items.name: Stop the Clock Tyrant
items.desc: A tyrant has frozen a whole district in a single second. Anyone who walks in stops too.

items.name: Soul Saber Thieves
items.desc: A gang is using a stolen soul blade to rip stands out of people. Find them before they find you.

items.name: Dragon of the Ember Peaks
items.desc: An ancient fire dragon has started burning trade caravans. Bring back proof.

items.name: Rift Breach at the Curio Shop
items.desc: The Hollow Clockmaker's back room tore open to somewhere else. Hold the line until it closes.

items.name: Escort the Phoenix Egg
items.desc: Carry an unhatched phoenix egg across the Ashen Wastes. It gets hotter every hour.

items.name: The Drowned Library
items.desc: A library sank into the lake a century ago. Its books are still dry, and still guarded.

items.name: Griffon Nest Raid
items.desc: Wild griffons are snatching livestock. Thin the nest, or tame one if you're brave.

items.name: Masked Assassin in the Court
items.desc: Someone at the noble court keeps dying at dinner. Find the killer before dessert.

items.name: Bounty: Bloodhound
items.desc: The infamous assassin was last seen near the Undercity. Bring her in alive for double pay.

items.name: Bandits on the Skyray Route
items.desc: Bandits with harpoons are bringing down flying mounts. Clear the route.

items.name: The Haunted Orchard
items.desc: Apples here scream when picked. The farmer just wants a quiet harvest.

items.name: Wolves at the Mill
items.desc: A dire wolf pack keeps circling the river mill at night.

items.name: Lost Caravan
items.desc: A supply wagon for Wayfarer's Stable never arrived. Find it and the driver.

items.name: Herbs for Old Mother Fen
items.desc: Collect moonleaf and ember root from the forest edge for the Verdant Apothecary.

items.name: Clear the Sewer Slimes
items.desc: The city sewers are bubbling again. Bring a torch.

items.name: Deliver a Letter to the Armory
items.desc: Brann Ashroot is waiting on an order slip. Don't read it.

items.name: Catch the Runaway Mule
items.desc: Marla Hoofwright's pack mule escaped again. It likes apples.

items.name: Sweep the Guild Hall
items.desc: Every adventurer starts somewhere. Brooms are in the closet.

items.name: Find Mrs. Kettle's Cat
items.desc: Whiskers was last seen chasing a butterfly toward the market.

nodes.d: Teleport anything you can see to anywhere you can see, instantly.
Rotate any object or person with precision, for offense or defense.
Slash away space itself: delete distance, or cut straight through a target. Can be molded into many shapes.
Create a field of infinite space around you. Attacks never arrive, or arrive from every side.
Fold space into a private room. Store items, hide allies or trap a foe for 3 turns.
Speed up your personal time: move, think and act like a speedster.
See the possible futures branching from what is happening right now.
Rewind time to heal or undo an action, keeping your memories.
Stop time. Each use lasts a little longer than the last.
Your blade touches the soul directly and can awaken soul-bound stands.
Cut an ally with the Saber of Souls to awaken their stand for the rest of the fight.
Link with every stand user you awakened. Share HP and energy across the bond.
Your own stand manifests as a shield-bearer that takes hits meant for allies.
Your own stand manifests as a scythe-wielder that strikes when you do, doubling hits.
Fifth-dimensional awareness: see everything in every direction at once.
Process all information in real time at peak capacity, with sage-like instinct.
With Omni-Vision and Bright Thought, dodge every threat on reflex.
Rapidly regenerate HP and every kind of energy you use.
Take 2 actions per turn.
Take 3 actions per turn.
Halve anything (an attack, a wall, a lifespan) and add that half to yourself in any way.
Command every soul your saber has touched: allies' stands fight in perfect sync with yours.

jc0evcud6f.blurb: Daemon Brando's tree: space, time and soul, ending in Divine Divide and Soul Sovereign.

items.name: Level Up
items.desc: Gain a level right away. You also get your usual stat points for a level.

items.name: Triple Level Up
items.desc: Gain 3 levels at once, for a little less than buying them one by one.

items.name: Stat Pack
items.desc: 25 stat points to spend however you like.

items.name: Big Stat Pack
items.desc: 100 stat points.

items.name: Vitality Boost
items.desc: Raise your max HP by 500.

items.name: Mana Well
items.desc: Raise your max energy by 1,000.

items.name: Full Restore
items.desc: Refill your HP and energy completely.

items.name: Gold Exchange
items.desc: Trade 10 skill points for 500 gold to spend in the Iris shops.

items.name: Random Skill Roll
items.desc: The DM rolls you a brand-new skill of any rank, even an unknown one.

items.name: Skill Respec Token
items.desc: The DM refunds every skill you unlocked in one tree so you can rebuild it.

items.name: Extra Action Token
items.desc: Take one extra action on any turn. Single use.

items.name: Divine Blessing
items.desc: A god of Iris grants you one wish, within reason. The DM decides what that means.
